Spacious Outer Richmond 3 Bedroom Flat with Parking.
This inviting middle flat in a three-unit Outer Richmond building offers generous living space and classic San Francisco character. A spacious living room with a large window and traditional fireplace mantel provides a welcoming gathering space, while the roomy kitchen offers extensive cabinetry and ample counter space.
- 3 bedrooms and 1 bathroom.
- Spacious living room with crown molding and a traditional fireplace surround.
- Large kitchen with gas range, refrigerator, and abundant cabinet storage.
- Tiled kitchen floor and backsplash.
- Bathroom with a shower over the tub, sliding glass enclosure, and vanity storage.
